The exclusive Power Holes drilled pattern amplifies power, while the Hyper Gryp textured finish boosts spin, creating more penetrating shots with every swing.

16K Carbon Construction
: Premium build for maximum consistency and superior performance.
Tri-Clamp Reinforcement
: Increased stability, control, and reduced drag for faster swings.
Power Holes
: Exclusive drilled pattern to generate more power on attacking shots.
Hyper Gryp Finish
